name: aqa
description: Drive the UsableNet AQA for Agents Chrome extension from your coding agent. Start QA sessions, run accessibility evaluations, summarize results, and export annotated HTML reports — with the AQA extension installed in the user's regular Chrome.

bridge_port.title: Bridge port
bridge_port.description: Base port of the WebSocket bridge slot range this server probes (base to base+7, first free port wins). The UsableNet AQA for Agents extension always dials 127.0.0.1:31773-31780 and has no port setting, so leave the default unless you also run a custom extension build — a base outside that range never pairs.
